name: lambda_test.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================


; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; CVC5 higher-order logic for lambda support
(set-logic HO_ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

; Note: Tuples are generated as concrete types when used


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatype TopLevelDeclarations ((mk-TopLevelDeclarations (c Ref))))
(declare-datatype Calculator ((mk-Calculator (addOne (-> Int Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatype Any (
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Calculator (sel-Calculator Calculator))
  (null)
))

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Calculator ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Calculator (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Calculator ((this Ref)) Calculator
  (sel-Calculator (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Calculator ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Calculator this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.c: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!c ((this Ref)) Ref
  (c (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Calculator (TopLevelDeclarations!c this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; -----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Calculator:
; -----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Calculator Calculator)

; --- Direct lambda constraint: addOne = lambda: ---

(assert (! (= (addOne const-1-Calculator) (lambda ((x Int)) (+ x 1))) :named _xkassert1))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-Calculator const-1-Calculator))
  )
)
